question: Who has been appointed as India's next High Commissioner to Canada in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Kumar Verma.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sanjay Kumar Verma is an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer of the 1990 batch and is currently serving as India's Ambassador to Japan.**
 
• Gopal Baglay is an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer of the 1992 batch and is currently serving as India's High Commissioner to Sri Lanka.
 
• Pranay Kumar Verma is an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer of the 1994 batch and is currently serving as India's Ambassador to Vietnam.
 
• Prabhat Prakash Shukla is an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer of the 1991 batch and is currently serving as India's Ambassador to Sweden and Latvia.
